headline: Request to sign contract with Maintenance Tech. Inc., plus jet fuel taxes, nighttime arrivals at BTV, and artificial intelligence policy.
summary: The meeting covers a contract request with Maintenance Tech. Inc. and a presentation on the City of Burlington Artificial Intelligence Policy. It also includes updates on construction, sound insulation, finances, and quarterly operations.
